item.title: 📆 Top News Today Unprecedented strategic alliance : Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov
item.description: 📆 Top News Today 🤝 Unprecedented strategic alliance : Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov held talks with Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission of the People's Republic of China General Zhang Shengmin as part of a working visit to the People's Republic of China. 🔥 Blacked out and devastated: Russian troops launched a massive strike on Ukraine's power generation infrastructure facilities in Vinnitsy, Dnepropetrovsk, and Kharkov regions, which supplied electricity to defence industry enterprises and the AFU, as well as port infrastructure in Odessa region and ships used for military purposes. 💥 End of the line: Geran UAV strikes hit four locomotives near Sumy, Dnepropetrovsk and Komsomolskoye in Kharkov region. 👊 Slam dunk : the Tsentr Group's artillerymen neutralised the AFU manpower and positions in Dnepropetrovsk direction. 🎯 Hammered into the ground : UAV operators of the Vostok Group of Forces eliminated enemy manpower in Zaporozhye region. ▫️ Symbol of courage and unconquerable spirit : the 9th Separate Guards Motorised Rifle Brigade of the Tsentr Group of Forces was presented with the Order of Suvorov. Delivering results! #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue delivering strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres and ships employed to deliver military-purpose cargo
item.description: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue delivering strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres and ships employed to deliver military-purpose cargo to the AFU. 💥 Today, as a result of a strike, the Novaya Pochta logistics centre in Berdichev (Zhitomir region), where military cargo supplied to the AFU by Western countries was stored and distributed, was hit . 🔥 In addition, a dry cargo ship delivering military equipment and dual-use cargo to Ukraine was hit in the Black Sea waters 24 km south of Odessa. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30415

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
The Sever Group of Forces improved its tactical situation.
In Kharkov region, Russian troops inflicted losses on formations of three mechanised brigades, one unmanned systems brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU close to Aleksandrovka, Tomakhovka, Fedorovka, Bugayevka, Rubezhnoye, Sonino, and Primorskoye (Kharkov region).
💥
In addition, in Sumy region,
strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades near Korenek, Gorki, Spasskoye, Putivl, Markovka, and Nikolskoye (Sumy region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 140 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 16 motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
⏩
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one assault brigade of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Izyum, Chervony Oskol, Ivanovka, Studenok, Monachinovka, Smorodkovka (Kharkov region), and Rubtsy (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 210 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations.
📍
Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
Russian troops inflicted fire damage on formations of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, one assault brigade, one airmobile brigade, and two assault regiments of the AFU close to Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Nikolayevka, Druzhkovka, Vysokoivanovka, Krasnotorka, Starodubovka, and Kondratovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 175 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 36 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's units inflicted damage on manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, two air assault brigades, one assault brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, one marine brigade, and three national guard brigades have been hit near Krivorozhye, Golubovka, Yakovlevka, Andreyevka, Sergeyevka, Belozerskoye, Varvarovka, Shavrovo (Donetsk People's Republic), and Ukrainka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
Up to 340 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, five motor vehicles, one Grad MLRS and one electronic warfare station have been neutralised.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 3 November 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see
Part 1
)
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
Russian elements engaged manpower and hardware of two air assault brigades, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Barvinovka, Zalivnoye, Tersyanka, Listovka, Vasilevskoye, Sergeyevka (Zaporozhye region), Kolomiytsy, Gavrilovka, and Katerinovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 215 troops, three armoured personnel carriers, and five motor vehicles.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
Russian units hit formations of one mechanised brigade, one mountain assault brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade near Kamyshevakha, Grigorovka, and Orekhov (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 25 troops, 15 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage
on port infrastructure facilities used by the Armed Forces of Ukraine, launch and storage areas of unmanned aerial vehicles, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 144 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
four Neptune long-range guided missiles and 1,265 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total,
since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy
has lost:

674
aircraft,

284
helicopters,
▫️
278,646
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
672
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
31,515
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,795
MLRS combat vehicles,
▫️
36,862
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
76,246
special military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
